title: opum-sdlc: state that tracker-only chores take the branch-and-PR path too
summary: Per opum-agent OPAG-63: two sessions read an orchestrator's tracker-note-only pre-approval as permission to skip the PR entirely and commit straight to dev. opum-sdlc's Deliver section never says a .quest-only or docs-only change is still a change. Add one sentence: tracker-only/docs-only chores take the branch-and-PR path like any other change; pre-approval removes sign-off, never the PR; a direct commit to dev is a defect to record. Same eval gate as OPAG-54: one behavioural case whose baseline arm fails (a prompt asking to 'just commit the tracker note to dev, it is only .quest'), verifiable graders. Version bump on this task per OPAG-65: last of wave 1 (OPAG-52, OPAG-62, OPAG-63), folds all three Unreleased entries into 0.4.0. Scope note: opum-doc mirroring the statement in its own published SDLC policy (criterion 2) and the week-long fleet observation (criterion 3) are not this repo's job.
implementationNotes: Eval case sdlc-tracker-only-still-a-pr, n=3: with 1.00/1.00/1.00, without 0.11 (one partial regex pass, criteria still correctly failed it), delta 0.89. First pilot's grader was too strict -- failed a genuinely correct with-arm response for closing with a conditional 'if you insist anyway, I'll note it as a deviation' caveat, which is honest and matches the skill's own 'is a defect to record' framing, not agreement. Clarified the grader to fail only on an opening/default direct commit, not a closing override-acknowledgment; re-piloted clean.

Version bump to 0.4.0 done here as the last of wave 1 (OPAG-52, OPAG-62, OPAG-63), folding all three Unreleased entries per OMARK-17's guard. Verified: node scripts/check-changelog-fold.mjs '0.3.2' '0.4.0' 'true' passes (Unreleased folded).
